requirement.statement: The system SHALL provide at least two immutable DomainContextBundle values through a production package that depends only on public contract/runtime roots, uses the live catalog/seed/bindings/probes API, stores semantic entries in catalog resources, exports no server or execution state, and authors each relational model with prefix ORM NamedConf on Kunun declarations: flat physical metadata on scalar Fields, relation metadata only on typed navigation Properties, and provider configuration on a DataSource whose declaration name is the sole identity.

case.given: both reference bundles using canonical model source
case.then: all definitions, bindings, probes, typed Property relations, model sources and complete presets SHALL be valid and frozen
business objects, association, lifecycle, constraint, process, capability and raw resources SHALL be represented without private schema types or a shadow relation graph

case.given: bundle production source, built output and package metadata
case.when: the boundary, canonical-residue guard and build run
case.then: only declared public roots SHALL be imported; old ORM forms, capsule, private, generated-authority, web-server and test paths SHALL be rejected

case.given: canonical bundle source exposed through the server catalog
case.when: the web workbench previews and executes a preset
case.then: the displayed source SHALL remain canonical and the resulting SQLite observations SHALL come from that same loaded bundle
